heading: Table 1.1. High-level summary of main inclusion and exclusion criteria: TB-PRACTECAL and ZeNix trials
data: • Aged 15 years and older • Aged 14 years and older • Confirmed TB and RR-TB • Confirmed MDR/RR-TB or pre-XDR-TB • Regardless of HIV status • Regardless of HIV status

• Known resistance to Bdq, Pa, Dlm or • Documented resistance to Bdq, Pa, Dlm or Lzd Lzd • More than 1 month prior use of Bdq, • More than 2 weeks of Bdq, Dlm or Lzd Pa, Dlm or Lzd • Pregnant • Pregnant or breastfeeding • Liver enzymes 3 times the upper limit of • Liver enzymes 3 times the upper limit of normal normal • BMI <17 • QTcF >450 ms and other risk factors for • QTcF interval on ECG >500 msec, history of QT prolongation (excluding age and congenital QT prolongation, history of tdp, gender) or other risk factors for tdp bradyarrhythmia • History of cardiac disease, syncopal • Karnofsky score <60 episodes, significant symptomatic or • Peripheral neuropathy of Grade 3–4 asymptomatic arrhythmias (with the exception of sinus arrhythmia) • Not expected to survive for more than 6 months • Moribund • Uncontrolled diabetes or cardiomyopathy, • Taking any medications contraindicated extrapulmonary TB requiring extended with the medicines in the trial treatment, cancer that could affect survival • Any baseline laboratory value consistent • Abuse of alcohol or illegal drugs with Grade 4 toxicity • CD4+ count <100 • TB meningoencephalitis, brain abscesses, osteomyelitis or arthritis • Use of zidovudine, stavudine or didanosine, use of MAO Inhibitors
